body_html:
The Rambler ottoman brings a relaxed, design-forward edge to collaborative and community spaces. This square 22-inch model groups effortlessly with other Rambler shapes to build lively lounge, reception, and breakout layouts that flex as fast as your team does. Tops and sides can be upholstered separately, so you can dial in exactly the look your space calls for.

Features

  • Square 22"W x 22"D footprint that clusters easily into casual, collaborative arrangements
  • Two seat heights — 15.5" on 1" legs or 17.5" on 3" legs — plus a standard-height caster option for quick repositioning
  • Tops and sides specifiable separately in fabric, vinyl or leather
  • Optional moisture barrier supports advanced cleaning protocols for healthcare and high-traffic environments
  • Leg finishes in Night or Sand
  • BIFMA LEVEL 3 certified and made in Canada

Specifications

Dimensions: 22"W x 22"D, with selectable seat heights of 15.5" or 17.5". Priced in Grade 1 fabric; vinyl and leather upholstery available. Backed by Global's Limited Lifetime Warranty on the frame, with 5 years on upholstery, foam and mesh.
